criteria.requirement: Add babel.numbers.format_number_range(start, end, *, currency=None, locale=None, collapse=True, **options). Require finite ordered Decimal-compatible endpoints. Format complete endpoints using existing format_decimal or format_currency with its options and numbering system, and join using the locale interval fallback pattern. Collapse equal rendered endpoints only when requested; do not elide currency/signs or change the old formatters. Reject reversed/nonfinite ranges and unknown currency codes.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
